ignoreValues.reason: reveal.js scales the whole 1920x1080 deck to fill the viewport, so em-based body text here renders large on screen despite the literal px value

reveal.js computes .reveal's base font-size dynamically from the actual viewport/stage size; at the deck's native 1920x1080 stage, computed sizes are 21-36px, well above the 11px floor - a smaller scan viewport understates reveal's own runtime scaling, same root cause as the already-ignored tiny-text finding

.mono is an inline code-style span sitting inside a running sentence (e.g. the quoted merchant-name examples on slide 3); its vertical padding is intentionally kept well under the 8px floor so the tag stays inline with the surrounding text's line-height instead of bulging above/below the baseline, matching standard inline-code conventions (GitHub, MDN, etc). Bumped 2px->4px as a free improvement; going further would break inline alignment.
